notes_for_human: Confirmed via WebSearch that Arrowstreet Capital is actively posting Summer 2027 internships (Quantitative Researcher Intern and Quantitative Developer Intern, both Boston, both on Workday under R1505-series requisition IDs), but the actual Workday job-posting pages and the CXS JSON API are both inaccessible to this tool (SPA rendering / 400 response), so none of the priority fields (class year, sponsorship, pay, cooling-off, dates) could be verified against primary source text. The two general company pages that did load — https://www.arrowstreetcapital.com/student-careers/ and https://www.arrowstreetcapital.com/professional-careers/ — describe a '10-week' summer program with internships across 'six' teams but contain no eligibility, sponsorship, pay, or cooling-off language; treat as silent only for those general pages, not for the job-specific postings. A search-engine snippet suggested a $3,500-$5,000/week pay range for the Quantitative Developer Intern role, but this was not confirmed by reading the source page directly, so it is omitted from the structured fields per the verbatim-or-omit rule. Recommend the human open the Workday links in an actual browser (JS execution required) to pull the verbatim eligibility/sponsorship/pay/cooling-off language.
